stage: 3 optimize (traced prefill engine + matmul program-config policy), one Blackhole P150 (chip 0)
workload_mapping: prefill-only pointer model: 'decode' maps to the traced question tail (one bucketed segment per question), 'prefill/TTFT' maps to the traced state chunk plus the server latency_ms of one request

device_vs_host_ms_per_question.note: forward is device time: the 2048-token chunk's Tracy kernel sum (190 ms per 4 layers before the policy) equals its wall clock; bucket 128 is op-count bound (about 5900 device ops per 32-layer forward at a per-program launch floor near 18 us)

parity_16_records_vs_fp32.revisits_equal: 16/16 with states interleaved (24 misses, 10 hits, 8 slots)

named_limitations: bucket 128 and 256 tails are launch-overhead bound: about 5900 device ops per forward, median kernel 6 us; needs fewer ops per GDN layer inside qwen36
fused GDN chunk op (ttnn.transformer.chunk_gated_delta_rule) is 25 % faster at bucket 128 but gave wrong carried-state results and a segfault; rejected
GDN output projection with fp32 activation (1.63 ms at 2048 tokens) is not covered by the matmul policy
dropping fp32 accumulation would give another 1.3 to 3.7x on the large matmuls but changes numerics; left to the stage 4 datatype sweep
one worker per chip serializes requests, so requests_per_s is flat across client counts
